scope: All raw bytes including decompressed authority gzip segments; exact keys and fixed credential formats only. No secret values emitted. Allowlisted synthetic fixture export source separately reviewed.
limitation: No finite pattern scan proves universal absence of secrets, PII, or memorized model text. Synthetic control content, model answers, prompt/code snippets, operational paths, IDs, expired fixture ownership tokens and historical synthetic attempts are in raw; publication consumes the holdout. Raw does not include private goldens, checker judgments, arm mapping file, auth/settings, credential stores or PG dumps.
